{{Short description|Blu-ray collection}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=January 2024}}
'''''Looney Tunes Collector's Choice''''' is a series of [[Blu-ray]] discs from [[Warner Bros. Home Entertainment]]'s [[Warner Archive Collection|Warner Archive]] division collecting various ''[[Looney Tunes]]'' and ''[[Merrie Melodies]]'' theatrical animated short subjects from [[Warner Bros. Cartoons]]. According to [[Jerry Beck]], the aim of this series is to release ''Looney Tunes'' and ''Merrie Melodies'' shorts that have been previously unavailable in restored form to animation fans and collectors on the various DVD and Blu-ray sets, such as the ''[[Looney Tunes Golden Collection]]'', ''[[Looney Tunes Platinum Collection: Volume 1|Looney Tunes Platinum Collection]]'', ''[[Looney Tunes Super Stars]],'' and ''[[Bugs Bunny 80th Anniversary Collection]]'' sets. Roughly 400 shorts had yet to be released in said DVD or Blu-ray format before the release of this series, but the series also includes shorts that were previously released as bonus features on various Warner Bros. DVDs. However those shorts included as bonus features were usually presented in unrestored form, whereas the ''Collector’s Choice'' series uses newly restored versions.

This is the first ''Looney Tunes'' Blu-ray to be released through Warner Archive, as opposed to the main home video division (second overall home media release after the ''[[Porky Pig 101]]'' DVD set in 2017). A four-disc set, ''Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volumes 1–4'', containing the four volumes in the series was released on November 26, 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/movies/Looney-Tunes-Collectors-Choice-Volumes-1-4-Blu-ray/373021/ |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volumes 1-4 Blu-ray (Warner Archive Collection) |access-date=2024-10-18 |website=www.blu-ray.com}}</ref>

On March 14, 2025, Warner Archive announced a spiritual successor to the ''Collector's Choice'' series, entitled ''[[Looney Tunes Collector's Vault]]'' - which would include 2 discs and contain 50 cartoons, with the first volume releasing on June 17, 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=36122 |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 1 Blu-ray |access-date=July 16, 2026 |website=www.blu-ray.com}}</ref>

''Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 1'' was announced on March 28, 2023<ref>{{cite web |last1=Millard |first1=Tim |date=3 April 2023 |title=Warner Archive May Part 1 Release Announcement: Border Incident, Clash By Night, Looney Tunes Collector's Choice Vol. 1 |url=https://www.theextras.tv/podcasts/blog-post-wacannmay1-032723 |access-date=10 June 2023 |website=The Extras}}</ref> and released on May 30, 2023.<ref name="Vol1Announce">{{cite web |last1=Miller III |first1=Randy |date=15 May 2023 |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 1 Blu-ray |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/movies/Looney-Tunes-Collectors-Choice-Volume-1-Blu-ray/331779/#Review |access-date=10 June 2023 |website=Blu-Ray.com}}</ref> Keeping with tradition with other [[Golden Age of American Animation|Golden Age of Animation]] releases by Warner Archive (such as ''Popeye the Sailor: The 1940s'' and ''[[Tex Avery Screwball Classics]]''), ''Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 1'' is a single-disc set with no bonus material. The set contains 20 cartoons that were previously unavailable on DVD or Blu-ray, all presented uncut and digitally restored.<ref name="Vol1Announce" />

''[[Beanstalk Bunny]]'' (1955) and ''[[Catch as Cats Can]]'' (1947) were sourced from new 4K scans from the [[original camera negative]]s.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Beck |first1=Jerry |date=10 April 2023 |title=Looney Tunes Collectors Choice Vol. 1 |url=https://cartoonresearch.com/index.php/looney-tunes-collectors-choice-vol-1/ |access-date=10 June 2023 |website=Cartoon Research}}</ref> According to Jerry Beck, the set was delayed for almost a full year because the [[Library of Congress]] had difficulty shipping the camera negatives for ''Catch as Cats Can'' to the Warner Bros. Studio in Burbank.<ref name="Millard" /> The other cartoons on this set had previously been restored for the [[HBO Max]] streaming service in 2020<ref name="Thad">{{cite web |last1=Komorowski |first1=Thad |date=16 May 2023 |title=Thad K Reviews "Looney Tunes Collectors Choice" Vol. 1 |url=https://cartoonresearch.com/index.php/thad-k-reviews-looney-tunes-collectors-choice-vol-1/ |access-date=10 June 2023 |website=Cartoon Research}}</ref> - with Warner Bros. removing many of them from the service earlier that same year.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Spangler |first1=Todd |title=HBO Max Removes 256 'Looney Tunes' Shorts, Three Seasons of 'The Flintstones' |url=https://variety.com/2023/digital/news/hbo-max-removes-looney-tunes-flintstones-1235478064/ |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=January 3, 2023 |access-date=10 June 2023}}</ref> However, for this release Warner Archive corrected many of the errors initially made by HBO Max, such as [[Photoshopped]] title cards.<ref name="Thad" />

The set includes the following cartoons:<ref name="Vol1Announce" />

Animation historian and curator, [[Jerry Beck]] and Warner Archive President George Feltenstein indicated that strong sales of ''Volume 1'' could result in future volumes, with more cartoons and multiple discs.<ref name="Millard">{{cite web |last1=Millard |first1=Tim |date=23 May 2023 |title=Looney Tunes Review & Collector's Choice Vol. 1 Preview |url=https://www.theextras.tv/podcasts/blog-post-ltcc-052323 |access-date=10 June 2023 |website=The Extras}}</ref> On September 18, 2023, due to strong sales of ''Volume 1'', Warner Archive announced ''Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 2'' — which included 25 cartoons and was released on December 12, 2023.<ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=33279 |title=Warner Archive Announces October Releases |access-date=July 16, 2026 |website=www.blu-ray.com}}</ref>

This set included 25 cartoons never before released on DVD or Blu-ray - five more than on ''Volume 1''.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Miller III |first1=Randy |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 2 Blu-ray Review |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/movies/Looney-Tunes-Collectors-Choice-Volume-2-Blu-ray/346061/#Review |website=Blu-Ray.com |date=December 13, 2023 |access-date=19 December 2023}}</ref> In contrast to the previous volume, ''Volume 2'' focuses more on miscellaneous "one-shot" cartoons and characters.<ref name="Collector's Choice Vol. 2 Preview" />

Like the previous volume, only two cartoons - ''[[Brother Brat]]'' (1944) and ''[[Ghost Wanted]]'' (1940) - were specifically restored for this release, while the other cartoons - including ''[[One Meat Brawl]]'' (1947), which was initially released on the ''[[Looney Tunes Super Stars' Porky & Friends: Hilarious Ham]]'' DVD set in an unrestored form - were previously restored for [[HBO Max]] and [[MeTV]], with Warner Archive correcting the [[Photoshopped]] title cards - most notably on ''[[A Hound for Trouble]]'' (1951).<ref>{{cite web |last1=Komorowski |first1=Thad |title=Thad K Reviews "Looney Tunes Collectors Choice" Vol. 2 |url=https://cartoonresearch.com/index.php/thad-k-reviews-looney-tunes-collectors-choice-vol-2/ |website=Cartoon Research |date=December 11, 2023 |access-date=19 December 2023}}</ref> In addition ''[[Cross Country Detours]]'' (1940) had its original opening title sequence restored, as opposed to the [[List of Warner Bros. cartoons with Blue Ribbon reissues|Blue Ribbon]] reissue titles featured on previous releases.<ref name="Collector's Choice Vol. 2 Preview">{{cite web |last1=Millard |first1=Tim |date=12 December 2023 |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Choice Vol. 2 Blu-Ray Preview |url=https://www.theextras.tv/podcasts/blog-post-ltcc2-121123 |access-date=19 December 2023 |website=The Extras |publisher=Otaku Media}}</ref>

The set includes the following cartoons:<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=33335 |title=Warner Archive: Looney Tunes Collector's Choice Volume 2 Detailed for Blu-ray |access-date=July 16, 2026 |website=www.blu-ray.com}}</ref>

On January 23, 2024, Warner Archive announced ''Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 3'' — which also includes 25 cartoons and was released on March 12, 2024.<ref name="Vol3Annouce">{{cite web |last1=Millard III |first1=Tim |title=Warner Archive February & Early March Release Announcement |url=https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/warner-archive-february-early-march-release-announcement/id1567580798?i=1000642524281 |website=The Extras.TV |publisher=Otaku |date=23 January 2024|access-date=23 January 2024}}</ref>

Like the previous volumes, only two cartoons were specifically restored for this release - ''[[Mexican Joyride]]'' (1947) and ''[[Riff Raffy Daffy]]'' (1948) - while all the other cartoons - including ''[[Punch Trunk]]'' (1953), which was previously released as a bonus short on the ''[[Looney Tunes Golden Collection: Volume 6]]'' DVD set in an unrestored form - were previously restored for [[HBO Max]] and [[MeTV]], with Warner Archive fixing most of the [[Photoshopped]] title cards. ''Riff Raffy Daffy'' was originally released on the ''[[Looney Tunes Super Stars' Porky & Friends: Hilarious Ham]]'' DVD set but in an unrestored form. For this release ''Riff Raffy Daffy'' was given a brand-new transfer. Since the original [[Dye-transfer process|separation exposure negatives]] are thought to be lost, critics noted that while ''Riff Raffy Daffy'' doesn't look as pristine as the other cartoons on the set, it still looks far superior than on previous releases.<ref name="ThadKVol.3">{{cite web |last1=Komorowski |first1=Thad |title=Thad K. Reviews Looney Tunes: Collector's Choice Vol. 3 |url=https://cartoonresearch.com/index.php/thad-k-reviews-looney-tunes-collectors-choice-vol-3/ |website=cartoonresearch.com |publisher=Cartoon Research |date=22 February 2024|access-date=9 April 2024}}</ref> ''[[Hobo Bobo]]'' (1947) also had its original opening titles restored.<ref name="ThadKVol.3" />

The set includes the following cartoons:<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=33914 |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 3 Blu-ray |access-date=July 16, 2026 |website=www.blu-ray.com}}</ref>

On July 30, 2024, Warner Archive announced ''Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 4'' — which also includes 25 cartoons and was released on November 26, 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=34928 |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 4 Blu-ray |access-date=July 16, 2026 |website=www.blu-ray.com}}</ref> This time there were three newly restored cartoons for the set: ''[[Holiday for Drumsticks]]'' (1949), ''[[Muzzle Tough]]'' (1954) and ''[[Peck Up Your Troubles]]'' (1945). The rest - including ''[[Mouse-Warming]]'' (1952), which was originally included as an unrestored bonus short on the ''[[Looney Tunes Mouse Chronicles: The Chuck Jones Collection]]'' Blu-ray and DVD sets - were all previously restored for [[HBO Max]] and [[MeTV]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Komorowski |first1=Thad |title=The Thad Review: "Looney Tunes Collector’s Choice" Vol. 4 |url=https://cartoonresearch.com/index.php/the-thad-review-looney-tunes-collectors-choice-vol-4/ |publisher=Cartoon Research |date=18 November 2024 |access-date=15 December 2024}}</ref> The set also included two bonus cartoons: ''[[Stork Naked (1955 film)|Stork Naked]]'' (1955) and ''[[Lighter Than Hare]]'' (1960) presented in their original 4:3 aspect ratios (both cartoons were previously released on the ''[[Looney Tunes Super Stars]]'' DVD sets, however were cropped to 16:9).<ref>{{cite web |last1=Millard |first1=Tim |title=Top Cat's a Cool Cat! PLUS an EXCLUSIVE SNEAK PEAK of Looney Tunes Collector's Choice Vol. 4 |url=https://www.theextras.tv/podcasts/blog-post-topcatltcc4-092024 |website=The Extras |publisher=Okatu Media |date=20 September 2024 |access-date=20 September 2024}}</ref>

The set includes the following cartoons:<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=35272 |title=Warner Archive Announces November Releases |access-date=July 16, 2026 |website=www.blu-ray.com}}</ref>
